notes: An FPS is Shooter, and the goal answer picks free-for-all, which rules out the team presets: Arena Deathmatch is the free-for-all row, so that is the preset. Shape is the genre default lane-network, and it is unusually literal here — the answer says the sunflower rows provide cover and clear lanes, so the planting rows are the lanes and cover-los was added for them. I dropped the preset's cover-elevated because a small, dense, flat garden built for eight players has nothing to shoot down from, and adding towers or nests would buy elevation the prompt never asked for; path-loop and powerup-buffs stay, bent to garden paths that connect at both ends and pickups placed between the rows. Without a user I assumed scattered free-for-all spawns rather than two opposing bases, and left the map on P0 with no interiors, since a garden is all exterior.
